name: Electronic Supply
old_description: Electronic Supply is Kansas City’s trusted distributor for electrical connectors, wiring products, cable assemblies, and tools. Serving professionals in telecom, industrial, and OEM markets since 1952.
about:
Electronic Supply, based in Lenexa, Kansas, has operated as a low-voltage distributor since 1952. The company began as a supplier of electrical connectors, wiring products, cable assemblies, and tools for the Kansas City market.

Today the firm stocks a broad range of low-voltage products including data cabling and connectivity, switches, racks, backup power systems, cooling solutions, security cameras, access control hardware, audio-visual equipment, and installation materials. Its service portfolio covers systems design, print take-offs, RCDD drawing approval, subassembly and kitting, custom fabrication, product selection, project staging, and free local delivery in the Kansas City metro area. An on-staff Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) supports design and approval workflows, while the build group handles office networks, video surveillance, access control, backup power, and wireless access installations.

Electronic Supply serves government agencies, educational institutions, surveillance integrators, data networking and data center operators, and healthcare facilities, as well as telecom, industrial, and OEM customers. The company emphasizes compliance and efficiency for government projects, modern learning environments for schools, asset protection for surveillance, scalable infrastructure for data networks, and dependable solutions for healthcare.

The company cites its mission to simplify projects through integrity, reliability, and innovation, backed by long-standing vendor relationships that ensure quality products and on-time delivery. Differentiators include BICSI certification with an RCDD on staff, status as a Schneider Electric Elite Partner for APC and IT solutions, and a commitment to free local delivery, kitting, and assembly services that reduce project complexity.
